source: This difference explains why fusion can matter. Suppose an activation reads a large ZXNAME0000XZ output from ZXNAME0001XZ and writes another tensor back. If the activation can be performed as part of the ZXNAME0002XZ epilogue while results are still nearby, one round trip of a large intermediate may disappear. ZXNAME0003XZ explicitly treats epilogues as a place where scaling and elementwise work can be combined with the matrix result.[14]
zh: 这种差异解释了为什么融合很重要。假设一个激活从 ZXNAME0001XZ 读取一个大的 ZXNAME0000XZ 输出，并写回另一个张量。如果激活可以作为 ZXNAME0002XZ 尾声的一部分执行，而结果仍在附近，则大型中间体的一次往返可能会消失。 ZXNAME0003XZ 明确将尾声视为可以将缩放和元素工作与矩阵结果相结合的地方。 [14]
